name: Assistance for Establishment of On farm Storage for Sorting-Grading
benefit: - **For Construction of On-Farm Infrastructure:** Financial aid will be 50% of the unit cost or ₹1,50,000/- per unit, whichever is lower.- **For Machinery or Equipment Purchase:** Financial aid of 50% of the actual cost, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000/- per unit, whichever is less.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a farmer.
